QuestInfo.name: Gared's House
QuestInfo.0: It seems one can earn a much-coveted place in the Hunter's Hall of Honor by defeating a savage creature like the #bsnow monster#k. But is the village terror more than just a monster? You decide to speak with Gared, the village chief, to learn more.
